routes.evidence: Pinned CRAN-mirror implementation defines combined and within-sample midranks, relative effect, placement variances, studentized statistic, and Welch-style degrees of freedom.

routes.evidence: The CRAN manual identifies the Brunner-Munzel test as a test of stochastic equality, defines the relative effect P(X<Y)+0.5P(X=Y), cites Brunner and Munzel (2000), and notes that the implementation follows the corrected Neubert and Brunner (2007) formulation.
routes.boundary: Only the documented statistic and correction lineage transfer.

routes.citation: Brunner, E. and Munzel, U. (2000), The Nonparametric Behrens-Fisher Problem: Asymptotic Theory and a Small-Sample Approximation, Biometrical Journal 42(1), 17-25.
routes.evidence: The publisher record describes a rank procedure with consistently estimated asymptotic variance, arbitrary ties, heteroskedastic distributions, and a central-t approximation for n1,n2 at least 10.
routes.boundary: The article is statistical-method evidence, not WTI trading evidence.
